program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-141ea074.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    ones = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    sixes = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 6]

    segments = []
    for i, (r1, c1) in enumerate(ones):
        for r2, c2 in ones[i + 1:]:
            dr, dc = r2 - r1, c2 - c1
            if dr != 0 and abs(dr) == abs(dc):
                sr = 1 if dr > 0 else -1
                sc = 1 if dc > 0 else -1
                length = abs(dr)
                cells = [(r1 + k * sr, c1 + k * sc) for k in range(length + 1)]
                segments.append((cells, sr == sc))
                for r, c in cells:
                    if out[r][c] == background:
                        out[r][c] = 1

    for cells, slope_positive in segments:
        on_segment = set(cells)
        for r, c in sixes:
            if (r, c) not in on_segment:
                continue
            # A six on the connecting one-line extends the perpendicular diagonal
            # across the grid.
            dc_step = -1 if slope_positive else 1
            rr, cc = r, c
            while 0 <= rr - 1 < h and 0 <= cc - dc_step < w:
                rr -= 1
                cc -= dc_step
            while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                if out[rr][cc] == background:
                    out[rr][cc] = 6
                rr += 1
                cc += dc_step
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
print(program_path)
